name: The American College, Madurai
summary: The American College was established in 1881 at Pasumalai by Rev. G. T. Washburn under the American Board of Commissioners for Foreign Missions. Once affiliated to the University of Madras, it has been under Madurai Kamaraj University since 1965, and was among the first seven colleges made autonomous (1977–78). NAAC accredited it A+ (CGPA 3.47, third cycle) in 2022. It offers 32 UG programmes in aided and self-financed streams.
